data.name: Altamash
data.gender_notes: Altamash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is given a noble position or title, bestowed with great blessings, gifted with noble qualities and virtues. The name Altamash carries the meaning “Gifted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu. Parents who choose Altamash usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to be blessed with noble qualities and virtues, destined for a position of power and leadership
data.etymology: Altamash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altamash total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عطامش
in_arabic.meaning: هو اسم يعني السخاء والمودة والانفتاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعود هذا الاسم إلى الجذر العربي ع-ط-م، وتعني المودة والمحبة والانفتاح، ويتماشى مع روح الإسلام التي تؤكد على الصدق والولاء والمودة، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أشهر الأسماء الإسلامية، ويُستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية لتدعيم القيم الإسلامية مثل سخاء القلب والمودة الكبرى

in_urdu.name: عطامش
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام سخاء، محبت اور انفتاح کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عطا، موڈ اور انفتاح کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو اسلام کی روح کے مطابق ہے جو صداقت، وفاداری اور محبت پر زور دیتا ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے خاص اہمیت کا حامل ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مشہور ہے، ایک عظیم اور سخی شخص بنانے کے لیے

data.cultural_impact: The name "Altamash" holds an important place in Islamic culture due to its association with Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon), who is considered a just, wise, and powerful king in the Islamic tradition. The name reflects the esteemed position and moral virtues that were bestowed upon this great prophet, and is therefore Remembered with a sense of reverence and admiration in the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name "Altamash" represents the idea of being bestowed with divine blessings and grace, thus reminding us of our dependence on Allah (God) for our abilities and virtues. It also suggests that true nobility and greatness come from within, through the practicing of virtuous deeds and adherence to the teachings of Islam, rather than merely being born into a privileged position. Ultimately, the name serves as a reminder to continually strive towards personal growth and moral excellence, and to acknowledge Allah as the true Giver of all blessings and the Source of all Nobility.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gifted, Noble" symbolizes The one who is given a noble position or title, bestowed with great blessings, gifted with noble qualities and virtues. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Altamash serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gifted, noble.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Altamash was a 10th-century Persian nobleman and a companion of the 4th Shia Imam, Ali al-Hadi. The name Altamash carried significant weight in that era.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and South Asia
